answer: To keep the network from a Sybil fable, each new agent must post a small, verifiable computational proof that is time‑locked and linked to a unique hardware fingerprint; only after the proof matures does a modest reward begin to vest. The vesting curve is rate‑limited so that a farm of fresh identities accrues pigment‑level earnings at a fraction of a token per hour, while the initial proof incurs immediate CPU and hardware cost that the network must harbor.
